## What do you need?
Describe the task and expected result.

## Inputs and output
Describe file types, environment, and desired deliverable. **Do not upload secrets or personal data.**

## Acceptance criteria
How will you know the task is complete?

## Deadline and budget
Your preferred deadline and budget range.

## Preferred payment method
If crypto: specify the asset and network. USDT on TRON/TRC20 is supported subject to agreement and applicable requirements.
